banking-economy.title: How digital distribution shifts the balance of power towards the customer
banking-economy.summary: The insurance sector grapples with pressing issues like mis-selling and customer complaints, which hinder the efficacy of policies. However, digital platforms offer improved transparency, enabling consumers to make well-informed choices about their coverage options. By comparing policies, customers not only save on premiums but also gain better insights into their coverage. Additionally, digital channels simplify grievance resolution, fostering easier interactions with insurers.
